name: Kishou
source:
A shinigami who appeared in front of Natsuo. She looks like a junior high school student, but she's actually 864 years old. She is rough, violent, and gluttonous. She looks like a woman, but she's far from cute.

[Translated from [url=https://kaitaishinnyo.wixsite.com/captain-myaosuke/ikiru-character?pgid=kmt92opw-12b551ca-4bc7-4fcf-8844-c85e1f6173f3]official website[/url]]
